summary: Appends length bytes of the fill value a3 to a growable buffer: the data block lives at this+0x4 and the current size/end offset at this+0x8. First guards against size overflow (when -1 - size <= append length it raises via the sub_59AD49 length_error path) and against a zero append length. Then computes the new end position v4 = size + append length, validates that region with sub_599560, and when validation passes fills a3 into length bytes at (data + size) via sub_58BB10, advances the size at this+0x8 to v4, and writes a null terminator at the new end. Returns this.

operations.description: Overflow check: if (-1 - size at this+0x8) <= append length, invoke the sub_59AD49 error path (the std::length_error 'string too long' throw helper).
If the append length is zero, skip the append entirely and return this.
Compute the new end position v4 = &retaddr[size at this+0x8], i.e. current size plus the append length.
sub_599560(v4, 0) validates the memory region at the new end position; the append proceeds only when it returns non-zero.
sub_58BB10(data at this+0x4 + size at this+0x8, fill value a3, append length) fills that many bytes with a3 at the current buffer end (memset-like).
Advance the size at this+0x8 to the new end position v4.
Write a null terminator byte at (data at this+0x4)[old size], i.e. the final appended position.
